title: Astronaut Trends: A reproducible analysis of global human-spaceflight participation, 1961-2026
description:
Astronaut Trends is a reproducible data pipeline, published dataset, and interactive dashboard analysing six decades of human spaceflight. Drawing on Jonathan McDowell's General Catalogue of Astronauts (planet4589.org), it classifies every flown astronaut (1961-2026) by year of first flight, citizenship group (USA, Russia/USSR, China, Other), cumulative career duration in space (binned into five bands), and gender.

The archive contains: tidy machine-readable datasets (data/processed/); a Python reprocessing pipeline (scripts/build_dataset.py) that regenerates the analysis from the primary source; static figures and summary tables; the original R analysis for provenance; and a self-contained interactive web dashboard (docs/) with linked box-and-whisker, bar, sankey, chord, network, radar, heatmap and time-series visualisations. All JavaScript libraries are vendored locally so the dashboard renders with no external network calls.

Code is released under MIT; derived data and figures under CC-BY-4.0. Underlying source data is (c) Jonathan McDowell / Planet4589, used with attribution.
